SPXML-INLINE-FORM.ms_tools:
<view_delete_doc PROPERTY="1" CALLER-ENV="1" PARAM="_catalog_name" EXPR="
			if ( common.linking_views.ChildByKeyExists( _catalog_name ) )
			{
				Cancel();
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				_listKey = Int( ListElem.PrimaryKey );
			}
			catch( _zzz_ )
			{
				try
				{
					_listKey = Int( ListElem.id );
				}
				catch( _zzz_ )
				{
					return;
				}
			}

			if ( CallServerMethod( 'tools_auth', 'check_lds_access_obj', [ null, 'delete', _catalog_name ] ).error != 0 )
			{
//				ActiveScreen.MsgBox( ms_tools.get_const('c_access_error'), ms_tools.get_const('c_error'), 'error', 'ok' );
				alert( ms_tools.get_const('c_access_error') );
				Cancel();
			}

			switch ( _catalog_name )
			{
				case 'collaborator':
					if ( _listKey == tools.get_cur_user_id() )
					{
						ActiveScreen.MsgBox( ms_tools.get_const('nevozmozhnoudal'), ms_tools.get_const('c_error'), 'error', 'ok' );
						Cancel();
					}
					if ( ListElem.role_id == 'admin' && ListElem.is_arm_admin && ArrayOptFirstElem( XQuery( 'for $elem in collaborators where $elem/role_id = \'admin\' and $elem/is_arm_admin = true() and $elem/id != ' + _listKey + ' return $elem' ) ) == undefined )
					{
						ActiveScreen.MsgBox( ms_tools.get_const('rd41prmexi'), ms_tools.get_const('c_error'), 'error', 'ok' );
						Cancel();
					}
					break;

				case 'forum':
					xarrForumEntrys = XQuery( 'for $elem in forum_entrys where $elem/forum_id = ' + _listKey + ' return $elem' );
					if ( ArrayOptFirstElem( xarrForumEntrys ) != undefined )
					{
						if ( ! ActiveScreen.MsgBox( StrReplace( ms_tools.get_const('g7uz8h2luk'), '{PARAM1}', ListElem.name ), ms_tools.get_const('7ey6j94yku'), 'warning', 'yes,no' ) )
							Cancel();

						for ( catForumEntryElem in xarrForumEntrys )
							DeleteDoc( UrlFromDocID( catForumEntryElem.PrimaryKey ) );
					}
					break;
/*
				case 'resource':
					ms_tools.delete_resource( _listKey );
					return true;
					break;
*/
				case 'document':
					_documents = XQuery( 'for $document in documents where $document/parent_document_id = ' + _listKey + ' return $document' );
					if ( ArrayOptFirstElem( _documents ) != undefined )
					{
						bDeleteAllExists = TopElem.ChildExists( 'view' ) && TopElem.view.ChildExists( 'delete_all' );
						if ( ! bDeleteAllExists || ! TopElem.view.delete_all )
						{
							if ( ActiveScreen.MsgBox( ms_tools.get_const('l8h8rfxvm6'), ms_tools.get_const('7ey6j94yku'), 'warning', 'yes,no' ) )
							{
								if ( bDeleteAllExists )
									TopElem.view.delete_all = true;
							}
							else
							{
								Cancel();
							}
						}

						for ( _document in _documents )
						{
							doc = OpenDoc( UrlFromDocID( _document.PrimaryKey ) );
							doc.document.parent_document_id.Clear();
							doc.Save();
						}
					}
					break;

				case 'forum_entry':
					var del_counter = 1;
					function tree_delete( _parent_id )
					{
						var _cur_forum_entrys = XQuery( 'for $elem in forum_entrys where $elem/parent_forum_entry_id = ' + _parent_id + ' return $elem' );
						var _ent;

						for ( _ent in _cur_forum_entrys )
							tree_delete( _ent.id );

						DeleteDoc( UrlFromDocID( _parent_id ) );
						del_counter++;
					}

					_forum_entrys = XQuery( 'for $elem in forum_entrys where $elem/parent_forum_entry_id = ' + _listKey + ' return $elem' );
					if ( ArrayOptFirstElem( _forum_entrys ) != undefined )
					{
						if ( ! ActiveScreen.MsgBox( ms_tools.get_const('3dbh61rewx'), ms_tools.get_const('7ey6j94yku'), 'warning', 'yes,no' ) )
							Cancel();

						for ( _fe in _forum_entrys )
							tree_delete( _fe.PrimaryKey );
					}

					tools.update_forum_entry( OpenDoc( UrlFromDocID( _listKey ) ) );
					break;

				case 'document_comment_entry':
					var del_counter = 1;
					function tree_delete( _parent_id )
					{
						var _cur_document_comment_entrys = XQuery( 'for $elem in document_comment_entrys where $elem/parent_document_entry_id = ' + _parent_id + ' return $elem' );
						var _ent;

						for ( _ent in _cur_document_comment_entrys )
							tree_delete( _ent.id );

						DeleteDoc( UrlFromDocID( _parent_id ) );
						del_counter++;
					}

					_document_comment_entrys = XQuery( 'for $elem in document_comment_entrys where $elem/parent_document_entry_id = ' + _listKey + ' return $elem' );
					delete_all = true
					if ( ArrayCount( _document_comment_entrys ) != 0 )
					{
						dlgOptionDoc = OpenDoc( '//wtv/wtv_dlg_select_delete_comment_option.xml' );
						dlgOptionDoc.TopElem.name = ListElem.name;

						try
						{
							Screen.ModalDlg( dlgOptionDoc );
						}
						catch ( err )
						{
							if ( IsCancelError( err ) )
								break;
							else
								throw err;
						}

						delete_all = dlgOptionDoc.TopElem.delete_all;

						if (delete_all)
						{
							for ( _de in _document_comment_entrys )
								tree_delete( _de.PrimaryKey );
						}
					}

					_cur_entry_doc = OpenDoc( UrlFromDocID( _listKey ) );
					if (delete_all)
					{
						if ( _cur_entry_doc.document_comment_entry.parent_document_entry_id.HasValue )
						{
							while ( _cur_entry_doc.document_comment_entry.parent_document_entry_id.HasValue )
								_cur_entry_doc = OpenDoc( UrlFromDocID( _cur_entry_doc.document_comment_entry.parent_document_entry_id ) );

							_cur_entry_doc.document_comment_entry.child_num = _cur_entry_doc.document_comment_entry.child_num - del_counter;
							_cur_entry_doc.Save();
						}

						DeleteDoc( UrlFromDocID( _listKey ) );
					}
					else
					{
						_cur_entry_doc.TopElem.deleted=true;
						_cur_entry_doc.Save();
						Screen.Update();
					}
					return true;
					break;

				case 'event':
					_cur_event_doc = OpenDoc( UrlFromDocID( _listKey ) ).TopElem;
					break;

				case 'func_manager':
					Cancel();
					break;

				case 'doc_type':

					var iRes = CallServerMethod( 'tools', 'drop_doc_type', [ RValue( ListElem.PrimaryKey ), true ] );
					if (iRes == 0)
					{
						if (ActiveScreen.MsgBox( ms_tools.get_const('7g9si38w3k'), ms_tools.get_const('7ey6j94yku'), 'warning', 'yes,no' ))
							iRes = CallServerMethod( 'tools', 'drop_doc_type', [ RValue( ListElem.PrimaryKey ), false ] );
						else
							Cancel();
					}

					if (iRes < 0)
					{
						ActiveScreen.MsgBox( StrReplace( ms_tools.get_const('l5yg2nxigo'), '{PARAM1}', ListElem.name ), ms_tools.get_const('7ey6j94yku'), 'warning', 'ok' );
					}
					break;
			}

			DeleteDoc( ms_tools.get_url_from_catalog( _catalog_name, _listKey ) );

			switch ( _catalog_name )
			{
				case 'event':
					eventResultArray = XQuery( 'for $elem in event_results where $elem/event_id = ' + _listKey + ' return $elem' );
					for ( _event_result in eventResultArray )
						try
						{
							DeleteDoc( UrlFromDocID( _event_result.PrimaryKey ) );
						}
						catch ( err )
						{
							alert( err );
						}
					return true;
					break;

				case 'request_type':
				case 'response_type':
				case 'custom_report':
					ms_tools.verify_disp_object_blocks( disp_object_blocks.Doc );
					break;

				case 'event_type':
					tools.update_commons_event_types( true );
					break;

				case 'blog_entry_comment':
					ms_tools.validate_blog_entry_comments( _listKey );
					break;

				case 'doc_type':
				{
					ms_tools.verify_disp_object_blocks( disp_object_blocks.Doc );
					break;
				}
			}
			return true;
	"/>

	

	




	

	



	

	

	

	


	



	



	



	
	



	



	


	



	



	


	


	
	

	


	


	


	

	




	

	


	


	

	

	

	

	





	

	
	

	
	

	
	

	
	

	
	<get_tasks_data PROPERTY="1" ALLOW-CALL-FROM-CLIENT="1" PARAM="sTaskListParam" EXPR="
			oRes = new Object;
			oRes.error = 0;
			try
			{
				Request;
			}
			catch ( err )
			{
				Request = undefined;
			}

			try
			{
				if ( sTaskListParam == '' || sTaskListParam == undefined )
					throw 'no_data';
			}
			catch ( err )
			{
				oData = tools_web.get_user_data( 'task_id_list' );
				if ( oData == null || oData.task_list == '' )
				{
					oRes.task_num = 0;
					oRes.task_infos = '';
					return oRes;
				}
				sTaskListParam = oData.task_list;
			}

			iCounter = 0;
			sRes = tools.xml_header() + '';
			for ( task_id in String( sTaskListParam ).split( ';' ) )
			{
				oData = tools_web.get_user_data( 'task_' + task_id );
				if ( oData == null )
					continue;

				teTaskInfo = oData.teTaskInfo;
				if ( DataType( teTaskInfo ) == 'string' )
				{
					teTaskInfo = OpenDocFromStr( teTaskInfo, 'form=x-local://wtv/wtv_form_task_info.xmd' ).TopElem;
				}
				if ( Request != undefined && teTaskInfo.user_id.HasValue && teTaskInfo.user_id != Request.AuthObject.id )
					continue;

				sRes += teTaskInfo.GetXml( { 'tabs': false } );
				iCounter++;
			}

			oRes.task_num = iCounter;
			oRes.task_infos = sRes + '';
			return oRes;
	"/>

	
	

	
	

	
	
	

	
	



	
	

	


	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	
	


	


	


	



	
	



	
	

	

	

	


	


	


	


	


	


	


	


	




	


	


	


	

	


	


	

	


	


	
	


	


	

	


	


	

	<eval_remote_action PROPERTY="1" PARAM="oRemoteActionIDParam" PARAM="oParamsParam" PARAM="fldTopElemParam" PARAM="oScreenParam" PARAM="sDispTypeParam" EXPR="
			try
			{
				if ( oParamsParam == null )
				{
					throw 'no_data';
				}
			}
			catch ( err )
			{
				oParamsParam = new Object;
			}
			try
			{
				if ( fldTopElemParam == undefined )
				{
					throw 'no_data';
				}
			}
			catch ( err )
			{
				fldTopElemParam = null;
			}
			try
			{
				if ( oScreenParam == null )
				{
					throw 'no_data';
				}
			}
			catch ( err )
			{
				oScreenParam = ActiveScreen;
			}
			try
			{
				if ( sDispTypeParam != 'dialog' && sDispTypeParam != 'dlg' && sDispTypeParam != 'background' )
				{
					throw 'no_data';
				}
			}
			catch ( err )
			{
				sDispTypeParam = 'curent';
			}

			var iRemoteActionID = OptInt( oRemoteActionIDParam );
			var teRemoteAction = null;
			if ( iRemoteActionID == undefined )
			{
				try
				{
					iRemoteActionID = oRemoteActionIDParam.id.Value;
					teRemoteAction = oRemoteActionIDParam;
				}
				catch ( err )
				{
					catRemoteAction = ArrayOptFirstElem( XQuery( 'for $elem in remote_actions where $elem/code = ' + XQueryLiteral( String( oRemoteActionIDParam ) ) + ' return $elem/Fields(\'id\')' ) );
					if ( catRemoteAction != undefined )
					{
						iRemoteActionID = catRemoteAction.id.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			if ( iRemoteActionID == undefined )
			{
				oScreenParam.MsgBox( 'Action ID not found.', ms_tools.get_const('c_error'), 'error', 'ok' );
				return false;
			}
			if ( teRemoteAction == null )
			{
				teRemoteAction = tools.open_doc( iRemoteActionID ).TopElem;
			}

			if ( ObjectType( oParamsParam ) == 'JsObject' )
			{
				for ( sFieldNameElem in oParamsParam )
				{
					oXvar = teRemoteAction.wvars.GetOptChildByKey( sFieldNameElem );
					if ( oXvar != undefined && oXvar.silent )
					{
						continue;
					}
					teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( sFieldNameElem ).value = oParamsParam.GetProperty( sFieldNameElem );
				}
			}
			else if ( ObjectType( oParamsParam ) == 'JsArray' )
			{
				for ( oParamElem in oParamsParam )
				{
					oXvar = teRemoteAction.wvars.GetOptChildByKey( oParamElem.GetProperty( 'id' ) );
					if ( oXvar != undefined && oXvar.silent )
					{
						continue;
					}
					teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( oParamElem.GetProperty( 'id' ) ).value = oParamElem.GetProperty( 'value' );
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for ( fldWvarElem in oParamsParam )
				{
					oXvar = teRemoteAction.wvars.GetOptChildByKey( fldWvarElem.PrimaryKey );
					if ( oXvar != undefined && oXvar.silent )
					{
						continue;
					}
					teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( fldWvarElem.PrimaryKey ).value = fldWvarElem.value;
				}
			}

			var iSuccessCount = null;
			var iTotalCount = null;

			var iObjectsCount = 0;
			var SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS = teRemoteAction.wvars.GetOptChildByKey( 'SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS' );
			if ( SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS != undefined )
			{
				SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS = SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS.value.Value.split( ';' );
				iObjectsCount = ArrayCount( SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS );
				if ( iObjectsCount == 1 && ArrayFirstElem( SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS ) == '' )
				{
					SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS = '';
					iObjectsCount = 0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS = '';
				iObjectsCount = 0;
				teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS' ).value = '';
			}
			var OBJECT_ID = teRemoteAction.wvars.GetOptChildByKey( 'OBJECT_ID' );
			if ( OBJECT_ID != undefined )
			{
				OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID.value.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				OBJECT_ID = '';
				teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'OBJECT_ID' ).value = '';
			}

			var catApplication = tools_app.get_cur_application();
			if ( catApplication != undefined && catApplication != null )
			{
				teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'sAPPLICATION' ).value = catApplication.code;
				teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'APPLICATION' ).value = catApplication.id;
			}

			var bMultiEval = sDispTypeParam == 'background' && SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS != undefined;
			if ( bMultiEval )
			{
				oTaskProgress = new TaskProgress;
                oTaskProgress.TaskName = teRemoteAction.name;
                oTaskProgress.ItemCount = iObjectsCount;
                oTaskProgress.CurrentItemIndex = 0;
			}

			if ( teRemoteAction.default_disp_evaluate && ( sDispTypeParam == 'curent' || sDispTypeParam == 'background' ) )
			{
				var sConfirmMsg = 'Выполнить действие "{PARAM1}" для {PARAM2} элементов?';
				if ( SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS == undefined )
				{
					sConfirmMsg = 'Выполнить действие "{PARAM1}"?';
				}
				if ( ! oScreenParam.MsgBox( StrReplace( StrReplace( sConfirmMsg, '{PARAM1}', teRemoteAction.name ), '{PARAM2}', iObjectsCount ), ms_tools.get_const('c_question'), 'question', 'yes,no' ) )
				{
					return false;
				}
			}

			switch ( sDispTypeParam )
			{
				case 'dialog':
				case 'dlg':
				{
					var docDlg = OpenDoc( 'x-local://wtv/wtv_dlg_eval_remote_action.xml' );

					if ( fldTopElemParam != null && fldTopElemParam.Name == 'remote_action' )
					{
						docDlg.TopElem.AssignElem( fldTopElemParam );
						if ( fldTopElemParam.ChildExists( 'resource_id' ) )
						{
							docDlg.TopElem.resource_id = fldTopElemParam.resource_id;
						}
					}

					docDlg.TopElem.remote_action_id = iRemoteActionID;
					docDlg.TopElem.remote_action_obj = teRemoteAction;
					docDlg.TopElem.params_obj = oParamsParam;
					docDlg.TopElem.top_elem_obj = fldTopElemParam;
					docDlg.TopElem.screen_obj = oScreenParam;
					oScreenParam.ModalDlg( docDlg );
					break;
				}

				case 'background':
				default:
				{
					var oRequest = tools_web.get_admin_request();

					function eval_action()
					{
						teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'curObjectID' );
						teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'curUserID' ).value = tools.get_cur_user_id();

						var oParams = new Object;
						for ( fldWvarElem in teRemoteAction.wvars )
						{
							oParams.SetProperty( fldWvarElem.name.Value, fldWvarElem.value.Value );
						}

						var oStepResult = CallServerMethod( 'ms_tools', 'eval_remote_action_step', [ iRemoteActionID, oParams ] );

						for ( sParamNameElem in oStepResult.params )
						{
							oXvar = teRemoteAction.wvars.GetOptChildByKey( sParamNameElem );
							if ( oXvar != undefined && oXvar.silent )
							{
								continue;
							}
							teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( sParamNameElem ).value = oStepResult.params.GetProperty( sParamNameElem );
						}

						var oRemoteActionResult = oStepResult.value;
						if ( oRemoteActionResult.error != 0 )
						{
							oScreenParam.MsgBox( oRemoteActionResult.messageText, ms_tools.get_const('c_error'), 'error', 'ok' );
							return false;
						}
						var oResult = oRemoteActionResult.result;

						iSuccessCount = OptInt( oResult.GetOptProperty( 'success_count' ), null );
						iTotalCount = OptInt( oResult.GetOptProperty( 'total_count' ), null );

						if ( ! eval_command( oResult ) )
						{
							return false;
						}
						return true;
					}

					function eval_command( oResultParam )
					{
						if ( oResultParam == undefined )
						{
							return true;
						}

						var sCommand = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'command', '' );
								var bValueIsArray = false;

						switch ( sCommand )
						{
							case 'display_form':
							case 'sign':
							case 'wizard':
							{
								arrFormFields = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'form_fields', [] );
								var arrButtons = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'buttons', [] );
								var arrPages = ( sCommand == 'wizard' ? ArraySelectDistinct( ArrayExtract( oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'pages', [ ({ name: ''}) ] ), '\'\'+This.name' ), 'This' ): [''] );

								if ( sCommand == 'sign' && System.IsWebClient )
								{
									var oSignParam = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'params', {} );
									for ( v in oSignParam )
									{
										if ( v != 'files' )
										{
											oSignParam.SetProperty( v, '' + RValue( oSignParam.GetOptProperty( v, '' ) ) );
										}
									}
									var _doc_url = oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'doc_url', '' );
									if ( _doc_url != '' && StrContains( _doc_url, 'download_personnel_document_file.html' ) )
									{
										var _url_query = UrlQuery( _doc_url );
										var _url_host = IsAbsoluteUrlStr( _doc_url ) ? UrlHost( _doc_url ): UrlHost( System.WebClientUrl );
										var _file_text = CallServerMethod( 'tools', 'call_code_library_method', ['libPersonnelDocument', 'download_personnel_document_file', [ _url_query.GetOptProperty( 'object_id' ), _url_query.GetOptProperty( 'file_id' ), _url_query.GetOptProperty( 'type' ), _url_query.GetOptProperty( 'is_compose' ), _url_query.GetOptProperty( 'no_disposition' ), _url_query.GetOptProperty( 'base64' ), _url_host ] ] );
										if ( _file_text != null )
										{
											oSignParam.SetProperty( 'doc_text', ( '' + _file_text ) );
										}
									}
									if ( oSignParam.HasProperty( 'files' ) )
									{
										var oFiles = oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'files', '' );
										if ( IsArray( oFiles ) && ObjectType( oFiles ) == 'JsArray' )
										{
											oSignParam.files = [];
											for ( ii = 0; ii < ArrayCount( oFiles ); ii++ )
											{
												_oVrem = {};
												for ( v in oFiles[ ii ] )
												{
													_oVrem.SetProperty( v, '' + RValue( oFiles[ ii ].GetOptProperty( v, '' ) ) );
												}
												oSignParam.files.push( _oVrem );
											}
										}
										else
										{
											oSignParam.files = [];
										}
									}
									EvalBrowserScript( '
										gWTSPCryptoParams = ' + EncodeJson( oSignParam ) + ';
									' );
								}
								var docDlg = OpenDoc( 'x-local://wtv/wtv_dlg_edit_list_item.xml' );
								docDlg.TopElem.title = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'title', '' );
								docDlg.TopElem.message = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'message', '' );

								var sHeight = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'height' );
								if ( sHeight != undefined )
								{
									if ( OptInt( sHeight ) != undefined && StrInt( OptInt( sHeight ) ) == sHeight )
									{
										sHeight = sHeight + 'vpx';
									}
									docDlg.TopElem.height = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'height', '' );
								}

								var sWidth = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'width' );
								if ( sWidth != undefined )
								{
									if ( OptInt( sWidth ) != undefined && StrInt( OptInt( sWidth ) ) == sWidth )
									{
										sWidth = sWidth + 'vpx';
									}
									docDlg.TopElem.width = sWidth;
								}

								if ( sCommand == 'sign' && System.IsWebClient )
								{
									sFileToSignName = oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'doc_name', '' );
									if ( sFileToSignName == '' && oSignParam.HasProperty( 'files' ) )
									{
										sFileToSignName = ArrayMerge( oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'files', [] ), 'This.GetOptProperty( \'doc_name\' )', '; ' );
									}
									arrFormFields.push( { type: 'heading', name: 'sign_header', label: 'После нажатия "Подписать" начнется процедура подписи документа "' + sFileToSignName + '" сертификатом ЭЦП "' + oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'cert_name', '' ) + '".' } );
									if ( oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'info', '' ) != '' )
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { type: 'paragraph', name: 'sign_info', label: '', value: oSignParam.GetOptProperty( 'info', '' ) } );
									}

								docDlg.TopElem.dialog_title = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'title', '' );
								docDlg.TopElem.disp_dlg_new_button = tools_web.is_true( oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'disp_dlg_new_button', '' ) );

								var arrButtons = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'buttons', [] );
								if ( ArrayCount( arrButtons ) != 0 )
								{
									docDlg.TopElem.buttons.Clear();
									for ( oButtonElem in arrButtons )
									{
										fldButton = docDlg.TopElem.buttons.AddChild();
										fldButton.name = oButtonElem.GetOptProperty( 'name', '' );
										fldButton.type = oButtonElem.GetOptProperty( 'type', '' );
										fldButton.title = oButtonElem.GetOptProperty( 'label', '' );
										fldButton.submit_type = oButtonElem.GetOptProperty( 'submit_type', '' );
									}
								}

								oScreenParam.ModalDlg( docDlg );

								arrFormFields = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'form_fields', [] );
								var sFieldName = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'field_name', '' )

								if ( sFieldName != '' )
								{
									if ( !docDlg.TopElem.multi_select )
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { name: sFieldName, type: 'string', value: ( docDlg.TopElem.object_id.HasValue ? docDlg.TopElem.object_id.Value: docDlg.TopElem.object_str.Value ) } );
									}
									else
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { name: sFieldName, type: 'string', value: ArrayMerge( docDlg.TopElem.values, 'key_str', ';' ) } );
									}
								}
								else
								{
									oField = ArrayOptFindByKey( arrFormFields, 'object_id', 'name' );
									if ( oField == undefined )
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { name: 'object_id', type: 'string', value: docDlg.TopElem.object_id.Value } );
									}
									else
									{
										oField.value = docDlg.TopElem.object_id.Value;
									}
									oField = ArrayOptFindByKey( arrFormFields, 'object_str', 'name' );
									if ( oField == undefined )
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { name: 'object_str', type: 'string', value: docDlg.TopElem.object_str.Value } );
									}
									else
									{
										oField.value = docDlg.TopElem.object_str.Value;
									}
									oField = ArrayOptFindByKey( arrFormFields, 'object_name', 'name' );
									if ( oField == undefined )
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { name: 'object_name', type: 'string', value: docDlg.TopElem.object_name.Value } );
									}
									else
									{
										oField.value = docDlg.TopElem.object_name.Value;
									}
									oField = ArrayOptFindByKey( arrFormFields, 'selected_object_ids', 'name' );
									if ( oField == undefined )
									{
										arrFormFields.push( { name: 'selected_object_ids', type: 'string', value: ArrayMerge( docDlg.TopElem.values, 'key_str', ';' ) } );
									}
									else
									{
										oField.value = ArrayMerge( docDlg.TopElem.values, 'key_str', ';' );
									}
								}

								teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'command' ).value = 'submit_form';
								teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'form_fields' ).value = EncodeJson( arrFormFields );
								if ( ! eval_action() )
								{
									return false;
								}
								break;
							}

							case 'open_doc':
							{
								var iDocID = OptInt( oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'doc_id', '' ), null );
								var bIsDlg = tools_web.is_true( oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'is_dialog', '' ) );
								var bIsEdit = tools_web.is_true( oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'is_edit', '' ) );
								var sCatalogName = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'catalog_name', '' );
								var sFormUrl = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'form_url', '' );
								var oSaveAction = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'post_action', '' );
								arrFormFields = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'form_fields', [] );
								var oVars = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'wvars', ({}) );
								var oDocInScreen = undefined;
								var oDocOutScreen = undefined;
								if ( bIsDlg )
								{
									if ( sFormUrl != '' )
									{
										sFormUrl = StrReplace( sFormUrl, '.xms', '.xmd' );
										var oForm = GetOptCachedForm( sFormUrl );
										if ( oForm == undefined )
										{
											oForm = OpenDoc( tools.get_object_form_url( sCatalogName, false ) ).TopElem;
											RegisterFormFromStr( sFormUrl, oForm.Xml );
										}
									}
									else
									{
										sFormUrl = tools.get_object_form_url( sCatalogName, false );
									}
									if ( iDocID == null )
									{
										oDocOutScreen = tools.new_doc_by_name( sCatalogName );
										oDocOutScreen.BindToDb( DefaultDb );
										try
										{
											oDocOutScreen.TopElem.id = oDocOutScreen.DocID;
										}
										catch( _noid_ )
										{
										}
										for ( _field_doc in arrFormFields )
										{
											if ( oDocOutScreen.TopElem.ChildExists( _field_doc.name ) )
											{
												oDocOutScreen.TopElem.Child( _field_doc.name ).Value = _field_doc.value;
											}
										}
									}
									else
									{
										oDocOutScreen = OpenDoc( UrlFromDocID( iDocID ) );
									}
									oDocInScreen = OpenNewDoc( sFormUrl );
									oDocInScreen.TopElem.AssignElem( oDocOutScreen.TopElem );
									try
									{
										oDocInScreen.TopElem.id = oDocOutScreen.TopElem.id;
									}
									catch( _noid_ )
									{
									}
									for ( oVar in oVars )
									{
										oDocInScreen.Url = oDocInScreen.Url + ( StrContains( oDocInScreen.Url, '?' ) ? '&': '?' ) + oVar + '=' + UrlEncode( oVars.GetOptProperty( oVar, '' ) );
									}
									oScreenParam.AuxData.SetProperty( sCatalogName + '_wvars', oVars );
									oScreenParam.ModalDlg( oDocInScreen );
									if ( bIsEdit )
									{
										oDocOutScreen.TopElem.AssignElem( oDocInScreen.TopElem );
										oDocOutScreen.Save();
									}
									if ( oSaveAction != '' && DataType( oSaveAction ) == 'object' && ObjectType( oSaveAction ) == 'JsObject' )
									{
										var sLibCode = oSaveAction.GetOptProperty( 'lib', '' );
										var sLibMethod = oSaveAction.GetOptProperty( 'method', '' );
										var sActionType = oSaveAction.GetOptProperty( 'action', '' );
										var sActionCode = oSaveAction.GetOptProperty( 'code', '' );
										if ( sActionType == 'lib' && sLibCode != '' && sLibMethod != '' )
										{
											CallServerMethod( 'tools', 'call_code_library_method', [ sLibCode, sLibMethod, [ oDocOutScreen.DocID, bIsEdit, tools_app.get_cur_application().id.Value, teRemoteAction ] ] );
										}
									}
									if ( bIsEdit )
									{
										DropXQueryCache();
										UpdateScreens( 'FrameMain', '*' );
									}
								}
								else if ( iDocID != null )
								{
									var sDocUrl = UrlFromDocID( iDocID );
									for ( oVar in oVars )
									{
										sDocUrl = sDocUrl + ( StrContains( sDocUrl, '?' ) ? '&': '?' ) + oVar + '=' + UrlEncode( oVars.GetOptProperty( oVar, '' ) );
									}
									var oDocScreen = FindOptScreenByDocUrl( sDocUrl );
									if ( oDocScreen != undefined )
									{
										if ( sFormUrl != '' )
										{
											oDocScreen = ObtainDocScreen( sDocUrl, sFormUrl );
										}
										else
										{
											oDocScreen = ObtainDocScreen( sDocUrl );
										}
									}
									else
									{
										oDocInScreen = OpenDoc( sDocUrl );
										if ( sFormUrl != '' )
										{
											oDocScreen = CreateDocScreen( oDocInScreen, sFormUrl );
										}
										else
										{
											oDocScreen = CreateDocScreen( oDocInScreen );
										}
									}
									oDocScreen.AuxData.SetProperty( sCatalogName + '_wvars', oVars );
								}
								else
								{
									oDocInScreen = tools.new_doc_by_name( sCatalogName );
									oDocInScreen.BindToDb( DefaultDb );
									try
									{
										oDocInScreen.TopElem.id = oDocInScreen.DocID;
									}
									catch( _noid_ )
									{
									}
									for ( _field_doc in arrFormFields )
									{
										if ( oDocInScreen.TopElem.ChildExists( _field_doc.name ) )
										{
											oDocInScreen.TopElem.Child( _field_doc.name ).Value = _field_doc.value;
										}
									}
									for ( oVar in oVars )
									{
										oDocInScreen.Url = oDocInScreen.Url + ( StrContains( oDocInScreen.Url, '?' ) ? '&': '?' ) + oVar + '=' + UrlEncode( oVars.GetOptProperty( oVar, '' ) );
									}
									if ( sFormUrl != '' )
									{
										oDocScreen = CreateDocScreen( oDocInScreen, sFormUrl );
									}
									else
									{
										oDocScreen = CreateDocScreen( oDocInScreen );
									}
									oDocScreen.AuxData.SetProperty( sCatalogName + '_wvars', oVars );
								}
								break;
							}

							case 'eval':
							{
								teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'command' ).value = 'eval';
								teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'form_fields' ).value = EncodeJson( oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'form_fields', [] ) );
								if ( ! eval_action() )
								{
									return false;
								}
								break;
							}

							case 'new_window':
							case 'open_window':
							case 'open_url':
							{
								_url = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'url', '' );
								if ( _url != '' )
								{
									if ( System.IsWebClient )
									{
										EvalBrowserScript( 'window.open(\'' + _url + '\', \'' + oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'target', '_blank' ) + '\')' );
									}
									else
									{
										_extDoc = OpenNewDoc( 'x-local://app/sx_view_html.xmd' );
										_extDoc.TopElem.html_url = _url;
										CreateDocScreen( _extDoc, 'x-local://app/sx_view_html.xms' );
									}
								}
								return false;
							}
							case 'download':
							{
								_url = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'url', '' );
								if ( _url != '' )
								{
									if ( System.IsWebClient )
									{
										ShellExecute( 'open', _url );
									}
									else
									{
										_localurl = Screen.AskFileSave( 'download_.' + UrlPathSuffix( _url ), 'file (*.' + UrlPathSuffix( _url ) + ')	*.' + UrlPathSuffix( _url ) + '	' + ms_tools.get_const('1d0p7epipp') + '	*.*' );
										_localurl = ( UrlPathSuffix( _url ) == '' ? _url + '.xml' : _url );
										CopyUrl( _localurl, _url );
									}
								}
								return false;
							}
							case 'reload_page':
							{
								DropXQueryCache();
								tools_app.clear_application_cache();
								_curScreen = FindScreen( 'FrameMain' );
								_curView = _curScreen.Doc.TopElem;
								_curDocID = '';
								if ( _curView.Name == 'view' && _curView.link_selector == 'preview' && _curScreen.FindOptItem( 'ViewGrid' ) != undefined )
								{
									if ( local_settings.view.preview_location == 'right' )
									{
										_frame = FindScreen( 'FrameLinkViewRight' );
									}
									else
									{
										_frame = FindScreen( 'FrameLinkView' );
									}
									if ( _frame != undefined )
									{
										try
										{
											_curDocID = '' + _frame.Doc.DocID;
										}
										catch ( _no_doc_ )
										{
										}
									}
									if ( _curDocID != '' && CallServerMethod( 'tools', 'check_access', [ _curDocID ] ) )
									{
										_curView.navigate_link( _curScreen.FindOptItem( 'ViewGrid' ), _curScreen, null, _curDocID );
									}
									else if ( _curDocID == '' && _frame != undefined )
									{
										_curView.navigate_link( _curScreen.FindOptItem( 'ViewGrid' ), _curScreen, null, '' );
									}
									else
									{
										_curView.link_selector.Clear();
									}
								}
								UpdateScreens( 'FrameMain', '*' );
								return true;
							}
							case 'call':
							{
								_fn = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'fn', '' );
								_fn_name = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'fn_name', '' );
								_fn_method = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'fn_method', '' );
								_args_array = oResultParam.GetOptProperty( 'args_array', '' );
								if ( _fn != '' && _fn_name != '' && _fn_method != '' )
								{
									try
									{
										if ( ObjectType( _args_array ) != 'JsArray' )
										{
											_args_array = ParseJson( _args_array );
										}
										if ( ObjectType( _args_array ) != 'JsArray' )
										{
											throw 'bad params'
										}
									}
									catch( _errr_ )
									{
										_args_array = [];
									}
									if ( StrBegins( _fn_name, 'tools' ) )
									{
										return CallObjectMethod( OptEval( _fn_name, null ), _fn_method, _args_array );
									}
									else
									{
										return tools.call_code_library_method( _fn_name, _fn_method, _args_array );
									}
								}
							}
						}
						return true;
					}

					if ( bMultiEval )
					{
						for ( iSelectObjectIDElem in SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS )
						{
							CheckCurThread();
							oTaskProgress.CurrentItemName = 'Object ID: ' + iSelectObjectIDElem;
                            oTaskProgress.CurrentItemIndex++;
							teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'SELECTED_OBJECT_IDS' ).value = iSelectObjectIDElem;
							teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'OBJECT_ID' ).value = iSelectObjectIDElem;
							teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'SELECTED_OBJECT_TOTAL' ).value = iObjectsCount;
							teRemoteAction.wvars.ObtainChildByKey( 'SELECTED_OBJECT_NUMBER' ).value = oTaskProgress.CurrentItemIndex;
							if ( ! eval_action() )
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if ( ! eval_action() )
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}

			if ( teRemoteAction.default_disp_evaluate && sDispTypeParam == 'curent' )
			{
				var sResMsg = 'Выполнено действие "{PARAM1}" для {PARAM2} из {PARAM3} элементов.';
				if ( iSuccessCount == null && iTotalCount == null )
				{
					sResMsg = 'Выполнено действие "{PARAM1}".';
				}
				else if ( iSuccessCount != null && iTotalCount == null )
				{
					sResMsg = 'Выполнено действие "{PARAM1}" для {PARAM2} элементов.';
				}
				oScreenParam.MsgBox( StrReplace( StrReplace( StrReplace( sResMsg, '{PARAM1}', teRemoteAction.name ), '{PARAM2}', iSuccessCount ), '{PARAM3}', iTotalCount ), ms_tools.get_const('c_info'), 'info', 'ok' );
			}
			return true;
	"/>
